text: Been up with my niece for hours. She's 7, temp's 39.1 I think, the thermometer jumped about a bit but that's what it settled on. Earlier she bumped her head on the table, cried straight away, and now she's completely back to normal I'd say, chatting, watching telly. Not sure if the head thing matters with the temperature or if they're separate. Just knackered and want to know if I can let her sleep
